title: Distilling Investigation Principles into Local Models
hypothesis: Fine-tuning a 7B local model on verified failure–correction–outcome traces will improve task success on unseen domains by at least 10 percentage points over both base models and positive-only trace training, with at most 3pp regression on general controls.
falsification_criteria: Comparative improvement falls below 10pp on unseen task families, or control benchmark regression exceeds 3pp.
